GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   D. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   C. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

7. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   C. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Soils as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.

9. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   C. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

14. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   B. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   C. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
